paragraphs: Today you turn 21, and I find myself completely lost for words — because how do you describe someone who changed everything? You walked into my life and suddenly the world made more sense, colors looked brighter, and every ordinary moment became something worth remembering.

I want you to know that loving you is the easiest thing I have ever done. There is something about the way you laugh, the way your eyes light up when you're excited, the way you care so deeply for everyone around you — it makes me fall in love with you all over again, every single day.

You are not just my girlfriend. You are my best friend, my biggest adventure, my calmest safe place. You are the person I think about when something funny happens. You are the person I want to call first when I have good news. You are the person who makes me want to be better.

On this beautiful birthday, I want you to celebrate yourself the way I celebrate you — completely, loudly, without holding back. You deserve every wish, every candle, every moment of joy today. You deserve the whole world, and I will spend every day trying to give it to you.
Thank you for your patience, your warmth, your love. Thank you for choosing me. Thank you for being exactly, wonderfully, perfectly you.
Happy 21st Birthday, my love. This is just the beginning.
